QUOTE: Every handler's write goes through one method, `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, which wraps `database.write` and `writer.batch`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says writes funnel through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, but it never says each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`. It also says some writes bypass `batchRecords`, which conflicts with the item's "every handler" conclusion.
